name: Re'hilah Isabella
quote: I recently had a blood, vitamin and mineral test from Xana Medtec. I was pleased with the service and knowledge the team held regards gut and yeast infections, they have provided me with a number of suitable options and also suggested I return in 3 months as a complementary visit to see how I got on with the suggestions. I was most impressed with the blood test, as it is difficult to get blood from my veins, I was provided with a hot beverage to ensure my veins were warm, did some arm exercises and the blood flowed with much ease. Thank you Xana Medtec for consideration and thoughts.
